## Outcome

The standard GSoC midterm evaluation window fell in this week. Public commit activity was light, so I used the checkpoint to review project state rather than inventing a milestone.

## What I Did

- Reviewed PR #285’s clearer facet errors.
- Reviewed PR #288’s custom-height facet layout tests.
- Reviewed PR #286’s positive `panel.margin` coverage.
- Reviewed PR #336’s legend-injection control.
- Reviewed PR #339’s multiline facet labels.
- Revisited the long-running PR #261 multiline-text feature.
- Reviewed collaborative PR #253’s `coord_equal` work.

## Learnings

The open set was no longer a list of independent issues. Text measurement, panel spacing, selector behavior, aspect ratios, and browser layout tests shared renderer boundaries. That connection made the second-half plan more coherent.

## Challenges / Notes

Several branches had been open for a long time. The next useful step was often to simplify a test or answer one review question, not add more implementation.

## Next Week Targets

Create a browser-geometry regression test for multiline facet-strip overlap and fix the layout, not only the text splitting.
